sentences.en: The statute of limitations has already passed for this crime.
sentences.zh: 对于这起犯罪，诉讼时效已经过了。

sentences.en: He got off because of the statute of limitations.
sentences.zh: 他因为诉讼时效已过而未受处罚。

sentences.en: I've heard there's no statute of limitations on murder.
sentences.zh: 我听说谋杀案没有诉讼时效。
